description_en: Modifies the LAN port configurations of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device
description_zh: 调用ModifySagLan修改智能接入网关设备的LAN口配置
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-lan --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --port-name 0 --ip-type STATIC --ip 192.XX.XX.1 --mask 255.255.255.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagLan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device that is associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备的序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en: The name of the LAN port
parameters.name: port_name

parameters.help_en:
The connection type of the LAN port. Valid values:

DHCP: a dynamic IP address. Uses the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) to dynamically assign an IP address to a connected device.

STATIC: a static IP address. Specifies a static IP address for the LAN port
parameters.help_zh:
LAN口连接类型。取值：

DHCP：动态IP。利用DHCP协议，向连接设备动态下发IP地址。
STATIC：静态IP。静态指定LAN口IP地址
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the LAN port
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The subnet mask of the LAN port IP address
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: The first IP address of the DHCP pool
parameters.name: start_ip

parameters.help_en: The last IP address of the DHCP pool
parameters.name: end_ip

parameters.help_en:
The time duration that the IP address is retained after it is assigned through DHCP. Unit: minute.

Valid values: 1 to 43200
parameters.help_zh:
DHCP租期。单位分钟。

取值范围：1~43200
parameters.name: lease
